scripts.format:core: prettier --write runtime/prepare-event.js runtime/load-machine-definitions.js runtime/plan-transition.js shared/machine-validation.mjs scripts/build-core.mjs runtime/core-layout.json && node scripts/build-core.mjs
scripts.format:core:check: prettier --check runtime/prepare-event.js runtime/load-machine-definitions.js runtime/plan-transition.js shared/machine-validation.mjs scripts/build-core.mjs runtime/core-layout.json && node scripts/build-core.mjs --check
